label: <button type="button" class="btn" style="margin-left:5px; transition: all 0.2s; display:inline-block; background: var(--btn-bg); color: var(--text-color); border: 1px solid var(--border-color);" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();try{var ta=document.getElementById('simple_message');var msg=document.getElementById('message');if(!ta||ta.value.trim()==='Nie wybrano żadnej komendy'||!ta.value.trim()){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Brak danych',2000);return false;}if(!this.dataset.copied){var txt=ta.value;if(msg) msg.value = txt; var btn=this;navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function(){UI.SuccessMessage('📋 Skopiowano!',2000);btn.dataset.copied='true';btn.innerHTML='✅ Otwórz Bazę';btn.style.setProperty('background','var(--btn-green-bg)','important');}).catch(function(e){UI.ErrorMessage('⚠️ Błąd kopiowania',2000);});}else{this.dataset.copied='';this.innerHTML='📋 Eksportuj';this.style.setProperty('background','var(--btn-bg)','important');window.open('https://twdatabase.online/attacks','_blank','noopener,noreferrer');}return false;}catch(err){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Błąd: '+err.message,2500);return false;}">📋 Eksportuj</button>
